<!-- generated by docs/generate.sh - edit the javadoc in src/, not this file -->

The classes a mod talks to, with the javadoc the source carries.

| Class | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| [CTMLAPI](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlapi) | The door into ctml: it runs a .ctml file, or markup held in a string, and puts the tree that comes out of it in the UIRegistry under a name. |
| [UIRegistry](/ctml/reference/java/uiregistry) | The trees CTMLAPI has run, under the names they were run as: the file name for one off disk, and whatever name was given for markup written in java. |
| [CTMLScreen](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlscreen) | A tree as a screen. |
| [CTMLHud](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlhud) | The same tree a CTMLScreen would open, drawn over the game instead of in front of it. |
| [CTMLRenderer](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlrenderer) | Lays a tree out into boxes and draws them. |
| [DOMContext](/ctml/reference/java/domcontext) | What a screen's scripts and callbacks talk to: the variables the host put there, the callbacks it registered by name, and the tree itself, which can be looked through by id. |
| [DOMTreeElement](/ctml/reference/java/domtreeelement) | An element in the tree: the CTMLElement it is, the properties written on it, the styles it carries and the children under it. |
| [DOMTreeNode](/ctml/reference/java/domtreenode) | One node of a tree, which is either an element or a run of text. |
| [CTMLCallback](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlcallback) | What a callback is handed: which element it is about, what happened to it, and the context it lives in. |
| [CTMLElement](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlelement) | What one kind of element is: its tag, the properties it can carry, whether it holds children, and the styles it starts with before any class list touches it. |
| [ElementStyle](/ctml/reference/java/elementstyle) | Every style an element can carry, named after the css property it comes from. |
| [TailwindParser](/ctml/reference/java/tailwindparser) | Turns a tailwind class list into an ElementStyle. |
| [CTMLDiagnostics](/ctml/reference/java/ctmldiagnostics) | Where the engine says something is wrong with a script without giving up on it. |
| [UIRenderer](/ctml/reference/java/uirenderer) | Where a tree is shown, and the one part of CraftyTML that is different on every platform. |
| [ScreenRenderer](/ctml/reference/java/screenrenderer) | The client's UIRenderer: a tree is opened as a CTMLScreen, over the screen that was showing when it opened, and a link goes through minecraft's own confirm screen. |
| [WindowRenderer](/ctml/reference/java/windowrenderer) | The server's UIRenderer, for one player: a tree is opened as a window in front of them, in place of any they had open, and a link is sent to their chat to click. |
| [HologramRenderer](/ctml/reference/java/hologramrenderer) | The UIRenderer for holograms: a tree is stood in the world at a location for everyone to see, in place of whatever this renderer showed before, the way a screen replaces the one before it. |
| [CTMLHolograms](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlholograms) | The holograms standing on a server, by id, all driven from one task that runs every tick. |
| [CTMLHologram](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlhologram) | A ctml tree standing in the world where everyone can see it: a CTMLSurface with no one player behind it. |
| [CraftytmlPaper](/ctml/reference/java/craftytmlpaper) | The Spigot/Paper/Bukkit entry point. |
| [CTMLWindows](/ctml/reference/java/ctmlwindows) | The ctml windows open on a server, at most one a player, all driven from one task that runs every tick. |
